_meta.purpose: Wording, timings and feature flags. ★ Edit here — changing any of this must NOT require shipping a new APK.
_meta.fetched: once daily by the elder device via GET /api/config; the device always keeps the last good copy and falls back to the values baked into the APK if it has never fetched successfully

alarm._comment_delay: ★ Screen lights BEFORE speech (spec §3.4-③). On a Kirin 710A this gap must stay ≤500 ms — never audio over a black screen.
alarm._comment_ring_series: Offsets in ms from scheduled_at for ring 1/2/3. 0, +10 min, +30 min.
alarm._comment_call: A dose due during a phone call waits until the call ends. It never interrupts a call (spec §4.4).

escalation._comment_missed: Consecutive unconfirmed doses before a MISSED_DOSE escalation is raised.

copy._comment: ★ Wording is bound to escalation state as an ASSERTION, not a convention (spec §7.6). A unit test enforces that no pre-delivery string contains 「已经」.

escalation_state_messages.FAILED: 我没能联系上{caregiver}，你可以自己打给她

tts._comment_rate: 0.85 measured as comfortable for 70+ listeners. Do not go below 0.7 — it starts sounding condescending.

ui._comment_font: Layout must survive 1.75× system font scaling (spec §3.4-④). Never hard-code heights.
